corrections.reason: The printed glyph has the 5th-order (ኀምስ) loop at the base of the stem: ከስሬ (Chosroes/Khosrow), the standard Ethiopic spelling of the Persian king.
The printed Ge'ez text reads ወይትብኡ ('and they shall make war/fight', from ተበአ, glossed immediately below as ይዋጋሉ), where the crossbar of ት was misread as ግ.
